game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ash bricks is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Test dataset 4: {'width': 5, 'height': 6}; {'width': 7, 'height': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about fair_trades to power up the ash ranger and open the smelter.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
